description:
## Description
This dashboard aims to provide a high-level overview of getting started with estimated usage.

Clone this dashboard and edit to match your organization's product usage by adding or removing product sections for a complete overview. 

See [documentation](https://docs.datadoghq.com/account_management/billing/usage_metrics/#types-of-usage) to learn more about estimated usage metrics. 

View your organization's actual usage on the [Plan and Usage page.](https://app.datadoghq.com/billing/usage?data_source=billable&summary_month=2024-01&trends_start_date=2024-01-01&trends_time_frame=monthly) (cloned)
